parameters.sqlQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_omset), 0) AS total_omset, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_trx FROM transaksi WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_omset), 0) AS total_omset, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_trx FROM transaksi WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN '{{ $json.tool_args.from }}' AND '{{ $json.tool_args.to }}'

SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_omset), 0) FROM transaksi WHERE DATE(created_at) BETWEEN '{{ $json.tool_args.from }}' AND '{{ $json.tool_args.to }}') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jumlah * harga_per_satuan), 0) FROM pembelian_bahan WHERE tanggal BETWEEN '{{ $json.tool_args.from }}' AND '{{ $json.tool_args.to }}') AS profit_bersih
SELECT id, nama, stok_menu FROM menu WHERE stok_menu IS NOT NULL AND stok_menu < 5 ORDER BY stok_menu ASC

SELECT td.nama_menu, SUM(td.subtotal_omset) AS total_omset, SUM(td.jumlah_porsi) AS total_porsi FROM transaksi_detail td JOIN transaksi t ON t.id = td.transaksi_id WHERE DATE(t.created_at) >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 day' GROUP BY td.nama_menu ORDER BY total_porsi DESC LIMIT 5
UPDATE menu SET stok_menu = COALESCE(stok_menu, 0) + {{ $json.tool_args.qty }}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE nama = '{{ $json.tool_args.menu_name }}'

INSERT INTO pembelian_bahan (nama_bahan, jumlah, satuan, harga_per_satuan, tanggal, created_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.tool_args.nama_bahan }}', {{ $json.tool_args.jumlah }}, '{{ $json.tool_args.satuan }}', {{ $json.tool_args.harga }}, CURRENT_DATE, NOW())

INSERT INTO pengeluaran_operasional (keterangan, kategori, jumlah, tanggal, created_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.tool_args.keterangan }}', '{{ $json.tool_args.kategori }}', {{ $json.tool_args.jumlah }}, CURRENT_DATE, NOW())

SELECT t.kode, t.tanggal, t.channel, t.total_omset, t.total_untung FROM transaksi t WHERE DATE(t.created_at) BETWEEN '{{ $json.tool_args.from }}' AND '{{ $json.tool_args.to }}' ORDER BY t.tanggal DESC
